data.content: APPROVED. The plan closes the random-UUID trust failure by binding an Ed25519 key fingerprint to every canonical, domain-separated proposal. It eliminates client writes to protected inbox refs: clients can only publish immutable untrusted proposal refs, while the default-branch Action validates the exact proposal OID as data and promotes with an exact old-OID lease. The dependency boundary is correct: knots-2af8 owns durable key state and must ship first. Negative tests cover forgery, replay, cross-writer/repository/ref substitution, stale OIDs, rotation misuse, altered payloads, and v0.17.6 fail-closed behavior. All legacy/archive data remains retained.
